lines.text: Many learners say: It is the biggest city of the country.
Better: It is the biggest city in the country.
In! It is the biggest city in the country.

data.wrong: It is the biggest city of the country.
data.right: It is the biggest city in the country.

quiz.stem: It is the biggest city ___ the country.

native.tip: En español “la ciudad más grande del país”, pero en inglés se dice “in the country.”
native.caption: 🙈 Error común: “It is the biggest city of the country.” Después de un superlativo, “de” se vuelve “in”: “It is the biggest city in the country.” ¡Escucha a Carlos y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
native.comment: Respuesta: “in”. Con “el más grande de un lugar” se usa “in”, no “of”. Escribe una frase tuya con “in” o dila en voz alta: {link}

en.tip: Learners say “del país”, but after “biggest” English says “in the country.”
en.caption: Common mistake: “It is the biggest city of the country.” After a superlative, “de” becomes “in”: “It is the biggest city in the country.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
